summary.text: Randall Terry is an independent candidate on the general-election ballot for Virginia's 7th District. He is the founder of the anti-abortion group Operation Rescue and has run for office in several earlier races. Ballotpedia lists no campaign profile, key messages or campaign finance activity for him in this race.

paragraphs.text: Born in 1959; Ballotpedia lists education at Elim Bible Institute (1981) and Whitfield College (1995).
Founded Operation Rescue, an anti-abortion organization, and led it until 1991.

Ran for Congress in Upstate New York in 1998 and for the Florida Senate in 2006, losing the Republican primary both times; ran in the 2012 Democratic presidential primaries and as an independent for Florida's 20th District that year.
Was the Constitution Party's nominee for president in 2024.
Ballotpedia also lists him as a withdrawn or disqualified candidate for New Jersey's 7th District in 2026; he will not appear on that ballot.
